testcase.system-out: Scenario: Deferred drawing loading clears and disables unresolved-file skipping ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens and saves each drawing to establish its sheet preview, then closes the drawings ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a saved drawing is selected with its Options pane displayed ✔ And Load in Defer Mode is unchecked ✔ And Skip all unresolved files is checked ✔ And `OpenDrawingB.odd` is selected in the Options pane ✔ When the user selects Load in Defer Mode ✔ Then Skip all unresolved files is unavailable ✔ When the user clears Load in Defer Mode ✔ Then Skip all unresolved files is available and unchecked ✔ And the selected drawing and its preview remain displayed
